title: In JetBrains YouTrack before 2026.2.19766 helpdesk email attachments were sent to CC recipients without a visibility…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains YouTrack versions before 2026.2.19766 caused helpdesk email attachments to be sent to CC recipients without performing a visibility check. This could lead to unintended disclosure of attachments to users who should not have access. The issue has a low severity score and does not affect integrity or availability.
